t: You are looking at numbers 10 and 12 Palace Court, a pair of Grade II star listed houses in Bayswater. They were designed by James MacLaren, a Scottish architect who died young, in 1890, at the age of thirty-seven. MacLaren is associated with the Arts and Crafts movement and with Scottish Vernacular architecture. He was a major influence on Charles Rennie Mackintosh. He also designed buildings in the Canary Islands, in Stirling and at Fortingall in Perthshire, so these London houses are one part of a short and widely spread career.
